campaign.portfolio_description: Postpaid mobility customers targeted for Add-A-Line cross-sell

include.logic: Include customers where line of business is 'Telus Postpaid', subscriber is the primary subscriber on the account, and subscriber status is Active

include.term: Target accounts with android for android, apple for apple
include.logic: Segment customers by device type: Android customers receive Android creative; Apple customers receive Apple creative. Segmentation splits into Samsung, Google (other Android), and Apple. Samsung or Google segments may be backfilled with other Android devices as needed.

exclude.term: Exclude customers that received an AAL campaign in the last 15 days
exclude.logic: Exclude customers where campaign code = AAL and medium = EM and in-home date is within the last 15 days and control flag = N

exclude.term: Exclude cx that AAL on their account in the past 30 days
exclude.logic: Exclude customers at the BAN (account) level who have added a line (AAL) within the past 30 days
exclude.threshold: AAL activity within last 30 days at BAN level

exclude.term: Scrub Credit class 'D' with =<8 months of tenure
exclude.logic: Exclude customers who have a credit class of 'D' AND tenure of 8 months or fewer
Exclude customers whose churn propensity model score falls in decile groups 1 or 2, using model ID 6535
Exclude customers whose language preference is French AND whose province is not Quebec (PQ or QC). Retain customers if province is QC/PQ OR language preference is not French.
exclude.threshold: Keep if Province IN ('PQ', 'QC') OR Lang_Pref != 'FR'

campaign_summary: This campaign targets active TELUS Postpaid primary subscribers (Base 1) via email for an Add-A-Line cross-sell, segmented by device type (Samsung, Google/Android, Apple) and geography (Quebec vs. Rest of Canada). Key eligibility exclusions include customers who received an AAL email in the last 15 days, customers who added a line at the account level in the last 30 days, high-churn-risk customers (churn decile 1-2 per model 6535), Credit Class D customers with 8 or fewer months of tenure, and French-language customers outside Quebec. Email opt-out, stop sell, and CASTL compliance suppression are applied as standard defaults.
